name: workledger-kit
description: Keep one deduplicated, approved open-item list and a navigable PR history for a repository: collect open items from .claude/output reports, open GitHub issues (read-only) and pull-request follow-ups; normalize and dedup them against Linear by an exact first-line key; plan them as per-source, hash-bound batches; assemble dated PR timeline and roadmap reports; produce a read-only digest of what is new; and verify a further repository's setup. Collects and plans only: every Linear or Notion write goes through workmanagement-kit's plugin-integration-intake approval gate, and GitHub is never written to.
